purpose: one-time locked-event localization evaluation of the frozen factorized source-conditioned low-rank operator
normalization: Each event's observation and predicted waveforms use the observation RMS, fixed across all source candidates.
reporting: Per event report waveform-only and waveform-plus-FMM-arrival estimates, eloc, et, objective components, and search time. Do not modify the model or settings after reading results.
decision_rule: Report the locked-set outcome as a one-time confirmation of this frozen operator. No hyperparameter changes or reruns on these events are permitted.
limitations: The eight FD records are synthetic and have been used in earlier studies of other frozen models. This comparison is locked with respect to the present operator, but it is not a prospectively collected field-data test.
